version: v1 (Tomás, round 4, 2026-10-01). Story: Nellie Bly at Amiens, 1889 (Wren r3). Wren's three: the toast, the page's wine named as ours, warm not cold and not hot. Red Bordeaux is our choice (the page names no wine); American rye after Imbibe! pdf 96-97 (1880s American bars put claret on whiskey; the New York Sour 'calls for rye'). Freeform: no Arnold style for an unchilled mixed drink; judged against stirred finished bands and fortified-wine strength.
